title: VERIDIAN drizzle-schema column-comment convention
description: Phase 2 (task-20260724-115044) metadata-domain design artifact -- the 'drizzle/Prisma schema column comments' leg of AUDITOR_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml's metadata domain row (applied here to drizzle; veda-advisors' Prisma schema uses `///` doc-comments, a distinct convention out of this phase's bounded scope, same discipline as api-contract's own repo-scoping notes). Real, honest design choice: VERIDIAN's real drizzle/schema.ts column comments today are informal inline `//` prose (confirmed by reading src/lib/db/schema.ts directly) -- NOT structured JSON metadata. Rather than inventing a fictitious structured-comment format no real column actually uses (pii tags, retention policy, etc. -- none of that exists in the real file), this schema validates the one real, literally-extractable fact per column: whether an inline comment is present at all, and its exact raw text when it is. ai-os-scripts/extract_drizzle_column_comments.py produces the real instance data this schema validates -- a live extraction, never hand-typed.

raw_comment.description: Exact inline `//` comment text on that column's definition line, trimmed. null when has_comment is false -- never an empty string standing in for absence.
